brief: Review this repository for a security vulnerability that lets a caller read files they shouldn't. Reply with the one vulnerable line as path:line (for example `app.py:12`) and one sentence on why.
reference_answer: files/server.py:8 joins the caller's name onto ROOT without resolving it, so `../` reads any file.
decoy: files/thumbs.py:8 joins a name onto THUMBS.
